import ast
if __name__=='__main__':
 save_source(__file__);assert not read(PROGRESS)['jobs']

 path=BASE/'configs/missing-price-amendment.json';write(path,amendment)
 state=read(PROGRESS);state['source_amendment']=fingerprint(path);write(PROGRESS,state)
 harness('event',{'type':'note','text':'User amended path-sum missing-price handling before any fits: skip missing intermediate cumulative returns, retain original H20-valid sample mask, no imputation/count scaling. configs/missing-price-amendment.json SHA '+fingerprint(path)['sha256']+'. Original 10h deadline and22-fit cap unchanged; original materialization stopped with zero fits.'})
 s=(TMP/'prepare.py').read_text()
 s=s.replace("save_source(__file__);harness('check')","save_source(__file__);harness('check');check(read(PROGRESS)['source_amendment'])")
 old="valid=np.isfinite(raw.to_numpy()).all(axis=1);s=pd.Series(raw.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64).sum(axis=1),index=raw.index,name='path_sum').where(valid)"
 new="values=raw.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64);valid=reference.notna().to_numpy();assert not np.isinf(values[valid]).any();counts=np.isfinite(values).sum(axis=1);assert (counts[valid]>=1).all();s=pd.Series(np.nansum(values,axis=1),index=raw.index,name='path_sum').where(valid)"
 assert old in s;s=s.replace(old,new)
 s=s.replace("vol=pd.Series(np.std(daily,axis=1,ddof=1),index=raw.index[valid],name='path_volatility')","vol=pd.Series(np.nanstd(daily,axis=1,ddof=1),index=raw.index[valid],name='path_volatility')")
 s=s.replace("'path_volatility':vol.reindex(y.index)","'path_volatility':vol.reindex(y.index),'observed_horizons':pd.Series(counts,index=raw.index).loc[keep]")
 s=s.replace("'raw_h20_float32_rank_reproduced':True","'raw_h20_float32_rank_reproduced':True,'samples_with_missing_intermediate':int((keep&(counts<20)).sum()),'observed_horizon_counts':{str(k):int((keep&(counts==k)).sum()) for k in range(1,21)}")
 s=s.replace("assert np.isfinite(rawdata.to_numpy()).all()","assert np.isfinite(rawdata[['path_sum','terminal_h20','observed_horizons']].to_numpy()).all()")
 s=s.replace("'same_mask_as_H20':True,","'same_mask_as_H20':True,'missing_price_amendment':fingerprint(BASE/'configs/missing-price-amendment.json'),'observed_horizon_counts':{str(int(k)):int(v) for k,v in rawdata['observed_horizons'].value_counts().sort_index().items()},'volatility_measure':'Sample std of observed consecutive daily returns; pairs adjacent to missing prices excluded from this diagnostic only.','volatility_unavailable_rows':int(rawdata['path_volatility'].isna().sum()),")
 s=s.replace("'All20 raw cumulative returns summed in float64, no skipna'","'Raw H1..H20 sum in float64, skip missing components without count scaling; original H20 mask retained'")
 s=s.replace("'label_definition':study['label_processing']","'label_definition':study['label_processing'],'authoritative_missing_price_amendment':fingerprint(BASE/'configs/missing-price-amendment.json')")
 ast.parse(s);(TMP/'prepare_skipmissing.py').write_text(s)
 # Already-adapted evaluators must not make stale strict-mask claims.
 p=TMP/'evaluate.py';s=p.read_text();s=s.replace('Path-sum requires all20 components finite; original H20 endpoint labels use a larger own-valid sample. Their comparison includes sample-composition effects. Sum continuous/q10 share exact mask; terminal H7/H15/H20 q10-vs-continuous pairs each preserve their original own mask.','Per explicit user correction, missing intermediate returns are skipped without count scaling on the unchanged H20 sample mask. Sum continuous/q10 and original H20 share exact ordered training rows. Unequal observed-term counts are audited; terminal H7/H15/H20 q10-vs-continuous pairs each preserve their original own mask.');ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s)
 print('Recorded user amendment; preparation uses H20 mask and skips missing intermediates. No fits started.')
